name: Ezra
summary: Ezra was a priest and a scribe, skilled in the law of Moses, who traveled from Babylon to Jerusalem. He made up his mind to study the LORD's law, keep it, and teach it in Israel.

key_moments.title: Goes Up from Babylon
key_moments.description: Ezra traveled from Babylon to Jerusalem, and the king gave him all he asked, for the LORD's hand was on him. He had made up his mind to study the LORD's law, keep it, and teach it.

key_moments.title: Weeping Before God's House
key_moments.description: Ezra prayed and confessed, weeping and lying face down before God's house, and a great crowd gathered and wept too. They agreed to put away the foreign wives they had taken, and Ezra made the leaders swear to it.

key_moments.title: Reading the Law
key_moments.description: The people gathered by the Water Gate and asked Ezra to bring out Moses' book of the law. He stood on a wooden pulpit and read from morning until midday, while the Levites helped the people understand.

key_moments.title: Tells the People Not to Mourn
key_moments.description: The people wept on hearing the law, but Nehemiah, Ezra and the Levites told them not to mourn, for the day was holy to the LORD. Gladness in the LORD would be their strength, so they went to eat, drink and share.
